label: One 4-line coercion guard, isolated single-file case

origin.note: Built for the OAI-221 overnight tuning matrix, 2026-08-26 — never scored by any run before this corpus. Small and single-file by design, to pair against hold1-exit-code's four-site defect at similar prompt size.

defects.description: normalizeFinding coerces raw.severity and raw.line with bare String()/Number() before any typeof check. A JSON-producible object with own toString/valueOf set to null throws TypeError out of the coercion, uncaught, crashing the whole reply's findings parse for one malformed finding rather than dropping just that finding.
